guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：科學級 CMOS 成像系統
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Scientific CMOS imaging systems
guides.concept: 從釘扎光電二極體與背照式結構出發，理解 sCMOS 為何能以 1 e⁻ 以下的讀出雜訊和 95% 的量子效率成像，再把滾動快門時序、光子轉移校正、DSNU/PRNU 校正與資料鏈路檢查整合成一套可驗收的科學相機工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the pinned photodiode and back-illuminated structure to see why an sCMOS can image with sub-electron read noise and 95 percent quantum efficiency, then integrate rolling-shutter timing, photon-transfer calibration, DSNU/PRNU correction and data-link checks into an acceptable scientific-camera engineering record.
procedure: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「滾動快門時序圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。剩下的讀出雜訊主要來自源極隨耦器的 1/f 與隨機電報雜訊，因此讀得越慢、取樣頻寬越窄，雜訊越低：同一顆相機在超靜音模式可達 0.7 e⁻，在快速模式約 1.6 e⁻。雙增益 ADC 同時以高增益與低增益數位化，再合成 16 位元輸出，兼顧低光靈敏度與全井動態範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

背照式感測器把完成電路的晶圓黏到載板上，從背面研磨與蝕刻到約 10 µm 的磊晶層，再以離子佈植與雷射退火做背面鈍化，形成把光生電子推向光電二極體的內建電場，最後鍍上針對可見光或近紅外最佳化的抗反射膜。矽的吸收長度隨波長快速增加，紅光與近紅外光子可能穿透整個薄矽層而不被吸收，因此矽越薄近紅外 QE 越低，但矽越厚電子橫向擴散造成的像素間串擾越大。感測器裝在充乾燥氣體或抽真空的封裝內，以熱電致冷器冷卻到 −8 °C 到 −45 °C，降低暗電流並避免結露。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子轉移曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

sCMOS 每個像素與每一行都有自己的放大器和 ADC，所以偏移與增益在像素之間各不相同：暗訊號不均勻性 DSNU 是無光時各像素偏移的空間標準差，光響應不均勻性 PRNU 是均勻照明下各像素增益差異的相對標準差，行級 ADC 的差異則表現為縱向條紋。這些是固定圖樣，不會因取平均而減少，卻可以用校正移除：以多張暗幀平均成主暗幀扣除偏移與暗電流，以多張均勻照明影像平均成主平場除去增益差異。熱像素（暗電流特別高的像素）另以地圖標記並在分析時遮蔽。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主暗幀與主平場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合相機時要同時滿足兩件事：每個像素收到的電子數要讓 SNR 達標，而像素在樣品面上的等效尺寸要符合奈奎斯特取樣。SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²)，其中 S = QE·N_ph 是訊號電子數，D 是暗電流，σ_r 是讀出雜訊；低光時讀出雜訊主宰，所以 1 e⁻ 與 6 e⁻ 的差異決定能否看見訊號。取樣方面，物鏡的瑞利解析度 r = 0.61λ/NA，像素投影到樣品面的尺寸 p/M 必須不大於 r/2；放大率太低會欠取樣失去解析度，太高則把有限的光子攤到太多像素而降低每像素 SNR。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SNR 模型與取樣匹配表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不只是核對資料表，而是把前面各單元的量測整理成一份可重現的紀錄：EMVA 1288 的增益、讀出雜訊、DSNU、PRNU、暗電流、線性度與動態範圍，附上量測時的冷卻溫度、讀出模式與韌體版本。時序方面要量觸發輸入到曝光開始的延遲與抖動，確認曝光結束訊號可用來同步光源或壓電台；資料鏈路方面要計算全幅、全速、16 位元的資料率是否在介面與儲存系統的能力之內，否則相機會丟幀而不報錯。交接時主暗幀、主平場、熱像素地圖與校正腳本必須隨相機一起交付。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收紀錄與資料鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term. The remaining read noise comes mainly from 1/f and random-telegraph noise in the source follower, so slower readout with narrower sampling bandwidth gives lower noise: the same camera reaches 0.7 electrons in ultra-quiet mode and about 1.6 electrons in fast mode. Dual-gain ADCs digitize each pixel at high and low gain simultaneously and merge the results into a 16-bit output, preserving both low-light sensitivity and full-well dynamic range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source follower and column ADC”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A back-illuminated sensor is bonded face-down to a carrier wafer, ground and etched from the rear to an epitaxial layer about 10 µm thick, then passivated by ion implantation and laser annealing to create a built-in field that drives photoelectrons toward the photodiodes, and finally coated with an anti-reflection stack optimized for the visible or near infrared. The absorption length of silicon rises steeply with wavelength, so red and near-infrared photons can cross the thin silicon without being absorbed; thinner silicon lowers near-infrared QE, while thicker silicon increases pixel-to-pixel crosstalk from lateral electron diffusion. The sensor sits in a dry-gas or vacuum package cooled by a thermoelectric cooler to between −8 °C and −45 °C, which lowers dark current and prevents condensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well. This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon-transfer curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because every pixel and every column of an sCMOS has its own amplifier and ADC, offsets and gains differ from pixel to pixel: dark-signal non-uniformity (DSNU) is the spatial standard deviation of pixel offsets without light, photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) is the relative spatial standard deviation of pixel gains under uniform illumination, and column-ADC differences appear as vertical stripes. These are fixed patterns that do not average down over time, but they can be corrected: many dark frames averaged into a master dark remove offset and dark current, and many uniform-illumination frames averaged into a master flat divide out gain differences. Hot pixels with unusually high dark current are mapped separately and masked during analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Master dark and master flat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integrating a camera means satisfying two things at once: each pixel must collect enough electrons for the required SNR, and the pixel's equivalent size at the sample must meet Nyquist sampling. SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²), where S = QE·N_ph is the signal in electrons, D the dark current and σ_r the read noise; at low light the read noise dominates, so the difference between 1 and 6 electrons decides whether a signal is visible at all. For sampling, the objective's Rayleigh resolution is r = 0.61λ/NA and the pixel projected onto the sample, p/M, must not exceed r/2; too little magnification undersamples and loses resolution, too much spreads the limited photons over too many pixels and lowers per-pixel SNR. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SNR model and sampling-match table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is more than checking a datasheet; it assembles the measurements from the earlier units into a reproducible record: EMVA 1288 gain, read noise, DSNU, PRNU, dark current, linearity and dynamic range, together with the cooling temperature, readout mode and firmware version in force at the time. On timing, measure the delay and jitter from trigger input to exposure start and confirm that the exposure-end output can synchronize light sources or a piezo stage; on the data link, compute whether the full-frame, full-speed, 16-bit data rate fits the interface and storage system, because a camera that cannot keep up drops frames silently. At handoff the master dark, master flat, hot-pixel map and correction scripts must travel with the camera. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance record and data link”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。
pitfallsEn: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.

Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.

related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」與「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" and "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CCD imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦背照式 sCMOS 的像素物理、讀出雜訊、快門時序、EMVA 1288 校正與系統訊噪比預算；科學級 CCD 成像系統則以背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on pixel physics, read noise, shutter timing, EMVA 1288 calibration and system SNR budgets for back-illuminated sCMOS; Scientific CCD imaging systems centres on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
history.text: CMOS 主動像素感測器由 NASA 噴射推進實驗室的 Eric Fossum 團隊在 1990 年代初發展，目標是取代功耗高、需要專用製程的 CCD；2009 年 Andor、Fairchild Imaging 與 PCO 共同發表第一代科學級 CMOS，以行級平行 ADC 與相關雙取樣達到約 1 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊與每秒 100 幀的全幅速度；2016 年前後背照式 sCMOS 把峰值量子效率推到 95%，2021 年量子型 CMOS（qCMOS）更把讀出雜訊降到 0.3 e⁻ 以下，使單一曝光能分辨光子數。本課只整理公開的物理與量測方法，不涉及任何廠商的製程細節。
history.textEn: CMOS active-pixel sensors were developed by Eric Fossum's group at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in the early 1990s to replace power-hungry CCDs that needed a dedicated process; in 2009 Andor, Fairchild Imaging and PCO jointly introduced the first scientific CMOS, whose parallel column ADCs and correlated double sampling reached about 1 electron of read noise at 100 full frames per second; around 2016 back-illuminated sCMOS pushed peak quantum efficiency to 95 percent, and in 2021 quantitative CMOS (qCMOS) brought read noise below 0.3 electron, allowing photon numbers to be resolved in a single exposure. This course collects only public physics and measurement methods, not any vendor's process details.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」到「相機驗收、觸發時序與資料鏈路交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" through "Camera acceptance, trigger timing and data-link handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
